Wonderful Dinner At The Capella
Feb 2026 • Couples
This is a lovely restaurant on the top floor of the Capella Hotel. We went one night for drinks and appetizers, then dinner the next night. It seems to be a hard reservation so make one in advance. 

Sitting at the bar was great we had shrimp cocktail and a nice cheese platter with cocktails. The next night for dinner my husband started with burrata and prosciutto and I had a Caesar salad to start. I had the steak and mashed potatoes and he the pasta. Ice cream for dessert. All delicious! View was lovely from our table. I recommend this restaurant for a nice dinner.
